# Bench Bridge

> Bench Bridge is a demo with sample data. It shows how older lab instruments can feed a laboratory information management system (LIMS) and controlled-substance ledgers.

## What the demo shows

- Each demo instrument has a concept drawing, a port, a bridge kit, sample readings and a delivery step.
- The LIMS and the ledger in the demo are mock systems. The ledger resets on each page load.
- The demo runs in the browser. It has no login.
- The bridge runs these steps in order: Capture, Parse, Normalize, Map, Deliver.

## Instruments

- Run in the demo with sample data: Analytical balance, High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) system, Gas Chromatography (GC) system, Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), pH meter, Karl Fischer titrator.
- Planned, with no demo yet: LC-MS/MS, Headspace Gas Chromatography (GC), Dissolution tester, FTIR spectrometer, UV-Vis spectrophotometer, Stability chamber, controlled-substance (CS) vault and safe.

## Limits

- All data is sample data. No real instrument, sample or ledger connects to the demo.
- Drawings and kits are concept. They are not to scale and they are not dimensioned.
- Kit parts are example parts. A part name is not an endorsement.
- The bridge is designed to support validation. The demo makes no claim of regulatory compliance.
